$comment: Animation state map for the Argus mascot (partial demo pack). THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for animation geometry: `pnpm generate` turns it into the renderer's CSS keyframes and into the AnimationState TypeScript union. Never hand-write a row offset, frame count or duration anywhere else.

idle.note: Idle facing right. Locomotion dwells pick idle/idle-left from facing.

idle-left.note: Horizontal flip of idle right, same pattern as running-left / jumping-left.

jumping.note: Jumping-jacks facing right. Broadcasts and the reaction map still name `jumping`; locomotion picks jumping-left/jumping-right from facing. One pass only: a second CSS iteration snapped 19→1 and stuttered.

jumping-right.note: Jumping-jacks facing right. Same frames as `jumping` / `stretch`.

jumping-left.note: Horizontal flip of jumping-jacks right, same pattern as running-left.

failed.note: Placeholder: reuses idle until fail art lands.

drink.note: All 11 drinking-water frames from the Argus pack.

running.note: In-place busy jog. Same art as running-right; the engine picks running-left/right from facing. Locomotion is still a run plan, not this state. Drag uses `panic`.

review.note: Thinking facing right. Locomotion picks review/review-left from facing.

review-left.note: Horizontal flip of thinking right, same pattern as idle-left / running-left.

stretch.note: All 19 jumping-jacks frames. Tuned to ~295ms/frame (was 147ms — looked like vibration). iterations:1 so the 19→1 restart hitch does not play mid-reminder; the sheet already contains two visual reps.

sleep-enter.note: Stand → lie down (argus-sleep frames 1–8). Slowed so the lie-down reads as a settle, not a drop.

sleep.note: Quiet on-ground loop (frames 9–18). Skips 19–23 which twitch eyes/legs.

sleep-exit.note: Stir then stand (frames 19–25). More frames than 24–25 alone, so the get-up can be slow without looking stuck.

electrocute.note: Zap from the hover thunderbolt. All 21 frames from argus-electrocute.

panic.note: Held for the whole drag. Stops the instant the pet is dropped.

aliases.$comment: Empty for the Argus partial pack: undrawn behaviours are real states that share a drawn row (same pattern as failed→idle), so the AnimationState union and motion engine stay complete.

freeCells.$comment: Unused (fully transparent) cells available for new frames without resizing the sheet.

reactionMap.$comment: trigger -> animation state. Keep this indirection so a new trigger is a mapping entry rather than renderer work. A value may name a state or an alias.
